descbody.para: This MMEL is made of Documentary Units (DU). The DUs contain the technical data.

unlist.para: In the MMEL, a DU can be:

descbody.para: The List of Effective Documentary Units (LEDU) lists all the DUs that constitute this MMEL.

The DUs are arranged into sections and subsections (also called PSL). The List of Effective Sections/Subsections (LESS) lists all the subsections that constitute this MMEL. The subsections contain the DUs.

item.para: The DU identification (Ident.). Each DU is identified by its unique identification number. This DU identification is used to cross-refer to the LEDU.

The DU date. For approved DUs (MMEL items DU), this date corresponds to the approval date by the EASA of the MMEL revision. For non-approved DUs, this date corresponds to the date of release of the DU by Airbus.
The "Applicable to" field that lists the aircraft to which the DU applies.

note.para: 0012-0220 means that the DU applies to all MSNs (listed in the AAT) from MSN 0012 up to and including MSN 0220.

descbody.para: In the electronic format, the same information is available by selecting the “DOC REF” option in the INFO drop down list. The electronic format also displays the “Criteria” field that indicates the aircraft configuration to which the DU applies.

unlist.para: For each DU, the LEDU indicates the following information:
The “M” field that may indicate the following Evolution Code:

item.para: The “E” letter indicates an aircraft validity change of the DU. The list of aircraft to which the DU applies has changed compared to the previous MMEL revision, by addition or deletion of one or several aircraft.
The “N” letter indicates a new DU added by this MMEL revision.
The “R” letter indicates a revised DU. The content of the DU is updated by this MMEL revision.

The "Localization" field that is the identification of the subsection that contains the DU. In the PDF format, this cross-refers to the page footer, which permits the user to localize the DU within the manual.
The DU identification (Ident.). Each DU is identified by its unique identification number. This DU identification is used to cross-refer to the LEDU.

The DU date. For approved DUs (MMEL items DU), this date corresponds to the approval date by the EASA of the MMEL revision. For non-approved DUs, this date corresponds to the date of release of the DU by Airbus.
The criteria: This field indicates the aircraft configuration to which the DU applies.
The "Applicable to" field that lists the aircraft to which the DU applies.

note.para: 0012-0220 means that the DU applies to all MSNs (listed in the AAT) from MSN 0012 up to and including MSN 0220.
